scope: Fixed Unicode 18 explicit paragraph bidi resolution, caller-supplied grapheme-aligned line L1/L2, logical coordinates and property lookup. Not automatic P1/script/font itemization, L3/L4 glyph painting, paragraph layout or Musterwork replacement.
artifactSizeScope: Incomplete development CLI/worker and Rust/C++ WASM artifacts only. Full rendering/media/fonts/host distribution and installer sizes are not measured here.

componentArchive.name: unicode-bidi
componentArchive.effectiveUnicodeData: 18.0.0 via explicit BidiDataSource override for both methods
componentArchive.implementation: Unmodified published Rust algorithm. MusterOffice owns bounded inputs, scalar coordinates, X9 omission, per-line L1 reset, budgets and host cancellation boundary.

limitations: The complete official bidi tests exercise rules through L2 only. They do not validate automatic P1 paragraph splitting, actual width-based line breaking, L3/L4 glyph painting or Office/WPS behavior.
Caller-supplied paragraphs allow a trailing separator/CRLF; internal B-class separators are rejected. Caller-supplied lines must cover the paragraph and align with extended grapheme boundaries.

X9-removed entries are represented as null and omitted only from the L2 permutation. Logical author text, including join controls, must remain intact for shaping; visualOrder is not a reordered string or final glyph order.
Script/style itemization, within-item font fallback, text width fitting, baseline metrics, vertical layout and rendering remain incomplete.

Unicode 18 bracket/class/mirroring tables override both unicode-bidi data-source methods. The published algorithm was unmodified; built-in Unicode 16 hardcoded data is not used by this implementation.

Paragraph resolution and L2 in the dependency are synchronous without internal cancellation callbacks. Input limits and pre/post cancellation checks do not establish a measured hard-cancellation latency; host process/Worker termination remains necessary.

Schema validation covers the supplemental bidi requests/responses plus selected prior reports. The 843 official conformance batches are compared against expected levels/order and Native/WASM bytes, not separately JSON-Schema validated.
No rendering/playback, advanced presentation objects, target Office/WPS acceptance, Agent distribution or Musterwork replacement gate is closed.
